name: How should homeowners prepare their space before tub installation begins?

mainEntity.name: How should homeowners prepare their space before tub installation begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clear all personal toiletries, bath mats, and shower curtains from the bathroom, and empty the vanity cabinet if plumbers need shutoff access under nearby sinks. Create a clear walking path from the home's exterior door to the bathroom by moving hall furniture, rugs, and wall hangings that could be bumped. If your home has a single main water shutoff valve, locate it beforehand and confirm that family members are prepared for temporary water shutoffs during pipe rough-ins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear out toiletries, remove entryway obstacles along hallways, and identify your main water shutoff valve so the crew has immediate, safe work access.
